RCA (Phase 1 complete) — CONFIRMED DEFECT, mechanism proven.

Root cause: the CLI transition text branch in src/rebar/_commands/transition.py (_emit_transition_result, the 'transitioned <id>: ... ; unblocked: ...' emit) never inspects result['completion_signature']. The sibling JSON branch (same function, transition.py:641-644) DOES forward it, and stderr carries a warning on the drift/sign_failed branches (transition_close.py:402-440). So a close that landed WITHOUT its completion attestation (cause in {sign_failed, material_drifted, force_bypassed}) prints an unqualified success on the default text channel.

Legitimacy: defect / incomplete-implementation. Authoritative sources: this ticket's AC1/AC3; parent bug rookie-fickle-hydra (3e21) AC3 ('a close that cannot obtain an attestation says so in its output'), already met for library/JSON/MCP and unmet only on text; and the JSON branch itself, which already carries the signal the contract promises.

Attribution (caused_by): f4cf-60b2-41c0-4843 (silvern-dewy-damselfly), commit 8f6b6c9356ee ('Report a close that landed without its signature'). That commit created the completion_signature contract and wired it to library/JSON/MCP/stderr but left the text branch (introduced earlier, 42cd70b889d5) unupdated — an unmet-obligation escape. Date test confirms the text site predates the contract, so it did not 'cause' it in isolation; the obligation-creating commit did. Close class: plan_defect.

Fix (Phase 2): additive/behavior-restoring — the text branch surfaces an adjacent warning line naming the un-signed cause when cause != 'signed'; signed closes, plain transitions, idea->closed, exit code (0), and --output json are all unchanged. RED->GREEN test in tests/unit/test_transition_close.py asserting observable stdout.
